channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Vermont Democrats swept the twenty twenty-six midterm elections, gaining control of Congress. Senator Bernie Sanders will chair a key Senate health care committee to push for Medicare for all. Congresswoman Becca Balint will focus on affordability and investigate Trump administration actions.

Independent grocery stores in Vermont are facing empty shelves due to a warehouse strike in New Hampshire. Deliveries have been disrupted, causing product shortages. Store owners are managing inventory amid the labor dispute.

Porter Medical Center nurses in Middlebury have approved a new three-year contract with annual wage increases. The deal includes better shift differentials, incentive pay, and bereavement leave. It covers one hundred forty-three nurses and was ratified by eighty percent of union voters.

A federal judge blocked county sheriffs from challenging New York’s ban on local immigration enforcement. The ruling supports Attorney General Letitia James’ authority to investigate local agencies working with ICE. The ban was enacted in May under Governor Kathy Hochul’s budget package.
